name: Quaternium-87
description: Quaternium-87 (CAS 92201-88-2 ), commercially available as Rewoquat PG 75, is a specialty quaternary ammonium compound used in personal care and cleaning formulations. It functions as a conditioning surfactant, providing surface modification and emulsification. This compound offers wetting performance across a range of rinse-off and leave-on systems. In hair care, it deposits onto negatively charged hair fibers during rinsing, reducing static and improving combability in conditioners and shampoos. Fabric softener formulations use it to impart softness and antistatic properties to textile fibers, particularly in rinse-cycle products. Skin care emulsions benefit from its emulsification and wetting properties for stable lotions. In industrial and institutional cleaning, it contributes surface-active performance to hard surface treatments and fabric care concentrates. This versatility makes it a staple in modern chemical manufacturing and product design. The material is typically supplied as a liquid or paste, depending on concentration and formulation base. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades, with Rewoquat PG 75 representing a recognized commercial specification. Buyers should confirm active content and carrier composition when evaluating grades for specific formulation requirements.
